descriptive_global.note: §6.3: reported descriptively, not as the cross-fitted primary estimate. Selected and evaluated on the same cases.

gate.wording_note: §6.3: an intentionally strict development triage rule, not the power-calibrated confirmatory test. Its conjunction with a point-estimate threshold has lower pass probability than the nominal interval power in §4 and must not be described as a 90%-powered gate.
